mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_ID AS userId, U.USER_PW AS userPw, U.USER_NAME AS userName, U.PHONE AS phone, U.EMAIL AS email, U.ENABLED AS enabled, U.REG_DATE AS regDate, D.WORK_STATUS AS workStatus, D.WORK_AREA AS workArea, D.WORK_TIME AS workTime FROM USERS U LEFT JOIN AGENT_DETAIL D ON U.USER_ID = D.USER_ID WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT USER_ID AS userId, USER_PW AS userPw, USER_NAME AS userName, PHONE AS phone, EMAIL AS email, ENABLED AS enabled, REG_DATE AS regDate FROM USERS ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS ( USER_ID, USER_PW, USER_NAME, PHONE, EMAIL, ENABLED, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userPw}, #{userName}, #{phone}, #{email}, 1, SYSDATE )
INSERT INTO USER_ROLES ( ROLE_ID, USER_ID, ROLE_NAME ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(ROLE_ID), 0) + 1 FROM USER_ROLES), #{userId}, 'ROLE_AGENT' )
